messages:
Maya P: FYI - Solaris private VPC migration target Fri 06:00 PDT. Need final validation: peering/TGW routes, IAM trust for cross-account role, CMK policy, and audit log ingestion. Owners: @Ethan S (network), @Ravi V (infra), @Lina T (security).
Ethan S: Network quick update: peering established, but customer sent two overlapping secondary CIDRs. We agreed on 10.48.0.0/16 as the final range. Preparing route commit with conservative blackhole rules to avoid overlapping leaks. Flow logs enabled -> s3://solar-flow, but PutObject currently denied from our logging principal.
Ravi V: Infra plan: I'll provision VPC endpoints for S3 and KMS and create the CMK with key rotation enabled. Will also attach a policy that allows our cross-account role to decrypt. Test run planned Thu 18:00 PDT. Minimal commands: `aws kms create-key --description "Solaris CMK"` then `aws kms enable-key-rotation --key-id <id>`.
Lina T: Security: drafted CMK policy in ticket CS-4999 requiring explicit principal ARNs (their cross-account role + our service role). Suggest CloudTrail multi-region -> S3 + Kinesis Firehose to their SIEM as preferred, but they asked for S3+SQS for now. I'll surface the tradeoffs to the PM. Legal flagged retention >90d as a potential contract change.
Maya P: Renewal risk captured: retention or residency asks could push this into an enterprise contractual review. Marked medium-high risk and added note to the renewal tracker.
Ethan S: Cost/ops note: image pulls during cutover may cause NAT egress. Propose pre-warming images to our cache and scoping NAT to deploy subnets during a 2-hour window. Will attach cost delta estimate to the route commit.
Ravi V: Preflight checklist: 1) assume-role into cross-account role and run KMS decrypt, 2) write/read to flow bucket, 3) call internal health endpoint from private host. Commands: `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::444455556666:role/Solaris-Redwood-Role --role-session-name smoke` then `curl -sS https://api.redwood.internal/health`.
ops-bot: ticket created CS-4999 assigned to Lina T, Ravi V; calendar event: "Solaris private migration - Fri 06:00 PDT" invited: Maya P, Ethan S, Ravi V, Lina T.
Lina T: Waiting on customer's IAM principal ARN (they might provide a role or user). Pinged their security PM for the exact ARN and log bucket name.
Maya P: Action items: Ethan finalize route commit (EOD), Ravi run preflight Thu 18:00, Lina finalize CMK policy and log-forwarding decision (Thu EOD). We'll run a 15-min retrospective 24h after migration and send a single-question feedback survey: "Was the migration clearly communicated and executed?"
Ethan S: No blockers on network once I get confirmation on the final CIDR.
Ravi V: If KMS decrypt fails in preflight, rollback plan is to hold routes and revert TGW peering. I'll prep rollback steps in the runbook.
Maya P: Thanks team. Once we have the bucket policy change and the IAM ARN, we should be green. :thumbsup:
